title: 용의 산 정상 특별 배송
description: 별빛 노을이 번지는 용의 산 정상에서 수달 배달부가 아기 용 가족에게 마지막 소포를 전하며 다섯 가지 변화를 찾아냅니다.
theme: 마법 배달부의 하루 — 용의 산 정상 마지막 별빛 배송
scene: A warm whimsical finale at a dragon nest on a high mountain summit at sunset, viewed straight-on from a comfortable medium-wide angle. A friendly recurring young otter courier in a deep-teal delivery coat has just arrived beside a cozy circular nest of pale stone and woven branches, while a gentle round mother dragon and one small smiling baby dragon welcome the final glowing parcel. Violet mountains and peach-gold clouds recede behind them, with tiny stars beginning to appear. At upper left, one large burgundy summit flag flies clearly from a brass-tipped pole; its free end has one broad square-cut tail. At center-left, the otter courier stands in profile with one oversized antique-gold rectangular buckle clearly visible on the outer side of the near boot. At lower center, one thick cobalt-blue climbing rope lies across a clear patch of pale rock and forms one large simple figure-eight knot. At center-right, the final cream parcel rests alone on a flat stone; it is tied with teal ribbon and has one oversized bright coral-red circular wax seal on its front, with no writing. At upper center-right, the baby dragon faces the viewer and wears one large vivid-turquoise round gemstone pendant on a short antique-gold necklace. Add blank canvas mail sacks, a small lantern, alpine flowers, smooth dragon eggs, warm nest blankets, and distant flying envelopes only as supporting atmosphere. Keep the square-tailed flag, boot buckle, rope knot, parcel seal, and baby dragon pendant large, crisp, unobstructed, spatially separated, and away from the outer 3% safe margin. No readable signs, labels, letters, numbers, addresses, logos, or clock numerals.
